Yuba Pass is one of the most northerly mountain passes in the Sierra Nevada that is well-paved, well-maintained and has steady traffic on it.
Overall the scenery is excellent with lots of trees and beautiful views all along the way.
Watch the snowmelt, the blind curves, the rocks.
This scenic mountain road off Yuba Pass connects visitors to the heart of the Lakes Basin Recreation Area
As you ride Gold Lakes Highway, you'll find charming, historic lodges tucked away at each major lake
The Sierra County side was still closed between the county line and Gold Lake as of Sunday, March 22, however.
